summary: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS amd64 managed CLI and toolchain added to the stable v0.1.0 release and qualified through the published bootstrap in a clean ubuntu:26.04 container.
evidence_tier_note: Accepted by Dan as the evidence tier for this target (2026-10-13): a clean ubuntu:26.04.1 container on a GitHub-hosted runner (real distro userland and archive, runner kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure), not a VM or physical host.

bootstrap_asset.change: replaced 881f1371… with the same script plus the ubuntu-26.04 target mapping

known_limitations: Container tier, not VM-backed host evidence.
No official package (arlen, gorm, tools-xctest) has an Ubuntu 26.04 artifact yet; package install/remove was exercised with a local fixture package.
Hand-built binaries need <root>/lib on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (libdispatch, libobjc2); the gnustep launcher and gnustep new templates handle this.
The Ubuntu 26.04 CLI reports 0.1.0 (version stamped at build time); the Debian 13 amd64/arm64 stable CLIs were built before stamping and still report 0.1.0-dev.
